key_insight: BReaD guides diffusion sampling toward high black-box rewards using a Gaussian process surrogate, without requiring a labeled training dataset or exact reward gradients.
engineering_relevance: The framework targets high-dimensional design and discovery problems where objective evaluations are scarce and gradients are unavailable.
method: Fit a differentiable Gaussian process surrogate to queried black-box rewards.
Use Upper Confidence Bound guidance to balance exploration and exploitation during diffusion sampling.
Actively query rewards for generated samples to refine the surrogate.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports scientific discovery and image generation experiments showing effective reward optimization in low-data settings, alongside a total-variation-distance analysis.
watch_item: Performance may depend on surrogate accuracy and uncertainty calibration in high dimensions; the abstract provides no quantitative gains or evaluation budgets.
paper_title: High-Dimensional Black-Box Optimization via Guidance Sampling of Diffusion Models
